extraErrors.message: Rendered work may fail (a throw in a memo or JSX expression, or a rejected async memo) and no Errored boundary is above it within this component or its callers up to the render root. At runtime the failure reaches the root and halts reactivity. Wrap the rendered work in <Errored fallback={…}>, or handle the failure where it is produced.

A possibly pending value is read in an event handler. An uninitialized read can throw or suspend even though a stale value can be served during refresh. Loading does not protect handlers. Avoid the pending read in the handler, or explicitly handle its uninitialized state and any failure.

extraErrors.message: A component's setup body (outside any memo, JSX or handler) may throw synchronously, or drops a promise that may reject (`risk().then(…)` with no catch); a component body only creates state. Move the failing work into a memo or rendered work under an Errored boundary, or handle it where it is produced.

Async value "props.value" is read in <Child>'s setup; while it is pending there is nothing to read. Read it in a tracking scope (JSX, a memo, or an effect's compute function) under a Loading boundary.
